sponsor.strongest_story: Trump administration to name Nvidia, Microsoft and OpenAI as AI 'National Champions'

lesson_card.plain_english: how one AI model launch can pull labs, customers, regulators, and national-security teams into the same accountability zone
lesson_card.big_question: Who gets to say a frontier model is safe enough before it launches?
lesson_card.simple_analogy: a product launch that drags the lab, the buyer, and the government into the same room before the confetti lands
lesson_card.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson_card.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand regulatory blast radius well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson_card.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson_card.episode_spine: Trump administration to name Nvidia, Microsoft and OpenAI as AI 'National Champions' shows frontier AI entering its inspection era before the launch button gets pressed.
